主要内容: On September 8, 2014, DISH Network Corporation appointed Afshin Mohebbi as an independent member of the Board, effective from the same date. The appointment followed the recommendation of the Nominating Committee, and Mr. Mohebbi will serve on the Audit, Executive Compensation, and Nominating Committees. Additionally, the Board approved an amendment to its Amended and Restated Bylaws, adjusting the number of directors to not less than three (3) nor more than eleven (11). The amendment is detailed in Exhibit 99.1 and incorporated by reference.
